default_settings.proposal_terms: Rates are exclusive of production/printing and mounting costs unless stated. 50% advance on confirmation, balance before mounting. Site availability is subject to confirmation in writing.

campaign_status.Upcoming: today before start date, or missing valid dates

campaign_alerts.Mounting overdue: no mounting date and today > start + mounting_grace_days while campaign has not ended
campaign_alerts.15-day due: no validation_15_date and today >= start + validation_interval while campaign has not ended
campaign_alerts.Final validation due: no final_validation_date and today >= end date
campaign_alerts.Campaign ending soon: no final_validation_date and today is within campaign_ending_warning_days before end
campaign_alerts.Invoice action: final validation exists and invoice not requested or invoice number missing
campaign_alerts.Hard copy pending: final validation exists, invoice number exists, hard_copy_status is Pending

site_status.Active: has a live active campaign today
